# NocoBase Documentation

> Learn and master NocoBase quickly

## Quick start

- [Quick start](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/quick-start.md): Create and start a NocoBase application, then build a transport workspace with one prompt.

## Capabilities

- [Overview](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/index.md): Explore the reusable capabilities available for your business application.
- [Authentication](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/auth/index.md): Explore default sign-in, accounts, sessions, API keys, and sign-in page customization.
- [Password authentication and accounts](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/auth/password.md): Sign in, manage employee accounts, set password requirements, and recover passwords.
- [API keys](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/auth/api-keys.md): ← Authentication overview · Open the related scenario An API key lets scripts, scheduled tasks, and external systems call application APIs without browser sign-in. By default, it represents its creator and uses that user’s existing permissions. A Northstar account manager can use a Key to send accessible transport orders to a reporting system, while continuing to use the application through browser sign-in. API keys provide programmatic credentials. The integration-key screen and order API below belong to the Northstar example; verify the actual endpoints, response fields, and user permissions in your application. Provide an integration keys entry · Create, save, and revoke · Read transport orders with a script · Result
- [Adding sign-in methods](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/auth/sign-in-methods.md): ← Authentication overview · Open the related scenario Northstar employees can use the company identity provider to enter the transport application. The provider verifies their identity; the application creates its own session and applies business permissions afterward. This guide uses OIDC as an example. Prepare an independent identity provider and account-linking rules first. Company sign-in is not enabled in the default application. Supported integration approaches · Prepare the integration · Corporate sign-in example · Other integration needs
- [Protecting pages and APIs](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/auth/protecting-access.md): ← Authentication overview · Open the related scenario Northstar can publish its transport service information while keeping customer records, orders, and its workspace internal. Authentication establishes whether a caller is signed in; authorization determines access afterward. The /main/services, /main/orders, and /main/api/northstar paths belong to this example. Ask the Agent to use your application’s actual routes, APIs, and base path. Public information and internal work · Use the current employee identity · Page and API requirements · Account lifecycle and deployment
- [Customizing sign-in pages](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/auth/login-pages.md): ← Authentication overview · Open the related scenario After setting up accounts and the required authentication methods, customize the sign-in page for your company. The sign-in page belongs to the application source. Its name, logo, copy, imagery, layout, and colors can follow a company brand while preserving authentication, error feedback, and password recovery. Customize application-owned branding, layout, and text while preserving the existing authentication actions, error handling, account rules, and recovery flows. Example: Northstar employee sign-in · View the result · Further customization
- [Data sources](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/data-sources.md): Choose an application database and connect existing business databases.
- [Data sources](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/data-sources/usage.md): Choose an application database and connect existing business databases.
- [Authorization](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/authorization/index.md): Authorization determines which pages employees enter, which actions they perform, and which records they access. Northstar account managers maintain transport demand, dispatchers assign drivers, and drivers handle their own tasks in one application. Authentication establishes identity. Requiring sign-in for orders is authentication; allowing a driver to handle only assigned tasks is authorization.
- [Permission sets and assignments](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/authorization/permission-sets.md): Permission sets combine pages, actions, and data scopes into reusable jobs. Multiple account managers can share a set, and employees can hold several sets.
- [Data scopes and rules](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/authorization/data-scopes.md): A data scope determines which records an action can access. Account managers view owned orders, while drivers view assigned tasks.
- [Default data access](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/authorization/default-access.md): Default data access adds a shared record scope for people who already hold the action. Northstar account managers can use completed orders as operational references alongside their own work.
- [Sharing rules](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/authorization/sharing-rules.md): Sharing adds record scope for selected people or registered organizational subjects. Recipients still need the corresponding page and action permissions.
- [Restriction rules](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/authorization/restriction-rules.md): Restrictions narrow existing access from jobs, common access and sharing. They do not grant an action or records on their own.
- [Inspecting permissions](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/authorization/inspector.md): Permission inspection explains actions, conditions, and sources. It is not a count of actual accessible records.
- [Workflow overview](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/workflow/index.md): Define multi-step processes, wait for people, external results or deadlines, and track execution.
- [Process definition and action control](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/workflow/definition.md): Define the stages a record passes through, the actions allowed in each stage and the next stage after each action. Actions can require designated people, mandatory information or conditions such as an amount limit. Different conditions can lead to branches or return to an earlier stage. The server checks these rules, while the page presents applicable actions. When two people process the same record simultaneously, the later submission must refresh instead of overwriting the result already saved.
- [Waiting, timeouts and reliable execution](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/workflow/execution.md): A workflow can pause for a person, an external result or a deadline, then continue. Waiting state is saved so processing can resume after application restart. Failed external calls can be recorded and retried. Repeated results must not advance the same business twice, and late results are handled according to the current stage. Later failures can also require compensating actions, such as releasing reserved vehicles or warehouse space.
- [Progress and processing history](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/workflow/progress.md): Workflows provide current stages, traversed paths and processing history. Users can see where a record is, what it is waiting for, and who performed each action, when and with what information. An application can display this information as a process diagram, stage bar or history list within business details. A process diagram presents execution progress; it is not a drag-and-drop process designer.
- [Approval overview](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/approval/index.md): Approval organizes the review and decisions for business requests, defining who reviews them, in which order and what constitutes approval. It coordinates multiple opinions, supports added reviewers, transfers and returns, and records decisions and changes in responsibility.
- [Multiple stages and conditional routing](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/approval/stages.md): Requests can pass through several review stages in order, with different responsibilities at each stage. Conditions such as amount or request type determine whether another stage is included. Reviewers may come from designated people, roles, departments or reporting relationships. Show an expected route before submission and determine actual reviewers on stage entry.
- [Joint review and decision rules](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/approval/joint-review.md): Several people can decide within one stage. The configured policy combines their opinions to determine approval, rejection or whether to keep waiting. Multiple stages progress through different review steps; joint review combines opinions within the same step.
- [Added reviewers and transfers](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/approval/handover.md): Add another person to an ongoing review or transfer the current task to an eligible person. Both operations retain the original reviewer, the new participant, reasons and subsequent opinions.
- [Request handling and progress](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/approval/requests.md): Approval can cover submission, review, correction, resubmission and completion. Applicants track progress, reviewers handle tasks and copied recipients read materials and opinions. Each role has its corresponding actions.
- [Task Center](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/task-center.md): Copy Agent prompts to connect approvals, equipment collection and other personal work to one entry point, including handling, counts and historical tasks.
- [Files](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/file.md): Add cargo documents to orders and see how to upload, save, preview, and download attachments with a complete business prompt.
- [Files](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/file/usage.md): Add cargo documents to orders and see how to upload, save, preview, and download attachments with a complete business prompt.
- [Language switching](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/i18n.md): Switch the interface language, add a language, and set the default in a NocoBase 3 application.
- [Language switching](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/i18n/usage.md): Switch the interface language, add a language, and set the default in a NocoBase 3 application.
- [Themes](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/theme.md): Use built-in themes and ask a Coding Agent to edit, add, or remove themes.
- [Themes](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/theme/usage.md): Use built-in themes and ask a Coding Agent to edit, add, or remove themes.
- [Notifications](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/notification.md): Send transport updates, follow their business links, and review delivery records.
- [Notifications](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/notification/usage.md): Send transport updates, follow their business links, and review delivery records.
- [Scheduled tasks](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/scheduler.md): Run business operations on a schedule, with a complete reminder example and administrator controls.
- [Scheduled tasks](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/scheduler/usage.md): Run business operations on a schedule, with a complete reminder example and administrator controls.
- [Mail](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/mail/index.md): Read and send email from your application.
- [Sync and Send Email](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/mail/quick-start.md): Add a mail center and reply to customer inquiries.
- [More Mail Features](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/mail/usage.md): Use signatures and templates, read customer correspondence, and compose from transport orders.
- [Mailbox Configuration](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/mail/configuration.md): Configure a provider and connect user mailboxes.
- [Developer Reference](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/mail/development.md): Integrate mail pages, permissions, and background jobs.
- [AI employees overview](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/ai-employee/index.md): An AI employee is an application assistant with a defined responsibility. It can use page context, query business data, call permitted actions following working instructions, and answer with company knowledge. Ask your development Agent to connect these capabilities and build the conversation and result views your users need.
- [Page context](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/ai-employee/page-context.md): Users often ask questions about the record they are handling. An application can provide its identifier and necessary context to an AI employee, so users can ask what to do next without copying the customer, route and status again.
- [Business queries](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/ai-employee/business-data.md): An AI employee can translate a natural-language question into an authorized business query, organize the records and provide page links. Connected reading actions supply current business data rather than only general advice.
- [Perform business actions](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/ai-employee/business-actions.md): AI employees can call business actions connected by the application, turning natural-language requests into work such as assigning a driver, creating a follow-up record, or preparing a notification. The application defines allowed actions, required inputs, confirmation, and how results are displayed. For data changes, an employee can present an operation plan before execution. Business actions still pass server-side permission checks, and reported results must match the actual records.
- [Responsibilities and work rules](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/ai-employee/work-rules.md): An AI employee's instructions can define who it serves, its tasks, response priorities, and work rules. Work methods can be included in these instructions. Runtime modes that support skills can also reuse them, allowing different assistants to approach the same business question according to their responsibilities. Instructions and skills guide how work is done. Application actions and permissions determine what can be executed. An employee's additional instructions cannot override application rules or the current task.
- [AI knowledge bases overview](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/ai-knowledge-base/index.md): A knowledge base organizes articles, files and business instructions into maintainable, searchable company material. Employees can read it directly or have an AI employee retrieve accessible content to support an answer.
- [Organize and import materials](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/ai-knowledge-base/organize.md): A knowledge base separates materials by space and organizes articles and files in folders. Articles suit business guidance that needs regular maintenance; files let you import existing materials. Uploaded files provide an original-file preview and extracted text for reading and search.
- [Read and search](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/ai-knowledge-base/search.md): Employees can open articles or files from the knowledge tree to read original business guidance, or enter keywords to find relevant materials. Search results show document titles, sections, and excerpts so users can judge relevance and return to the original context. Once the application connects semantic search, employees can describe their question in natural language and find related passages by meaning without knowing the exact wording.
- [Knowledge-based answers](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/ai-knowledge-base/answers.md): Company rules often live in documents. An AI employee can find accessible material, organize an answer around the question and provide sources for users to check and read further.
- [Access and collaboration](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/ai-knowledge-base/access.md): Knowledge spaces, folders, and documents can grant read, propose, edit, and manage access. Readers consult content, contributors propose changes, editors maintain content and review proposals, and managers can also change access. Documents can inherit access from their space or parent folder, or allow only specified members.
- [Versions and processing status](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/ai-knowledge-base/maintenance.md): Article and file updates retain version history so you can inspect previous content and compare changes. Extracting text from an uploaded file and building an index for semantic retrieval are separate stages: parsing completion means text has been extracted, while indexing status describes processing of the current document's sections.
- [Template printing](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/template-print/index.md): Generate business documents from Office templates and authorized application data.
- [Template printing usage guide](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/template-print/usage.md): Prepare templates, identify business data, and verify generated documents.
- [Extensions](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/approval/extension.md): Integrate and extend approval policies, operations, interfaces, deadlines, and reliable execution.
- [Developer reference](/nocobase-docs-vi/capabilities/workflow/extension.md): For developers reviewing or extending generated code. Business users can begin with Process definition and action control.

## Deployment

- [Application deployment](/nocobase-docs-vi/deployment.md): Deploy to your own server with PM2 or Docker, or deploy to NocoBase Studio. Choose a method and use an Agent or follow the manual steps.

## Other

- [NocoBase 2 vs 3](/nocobase-docs-vi/nocobase-2-vs-3.md): These three approaches differ in where business logic lives: configuration in a database, or source code in your own repository.
